infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Lexi uses the camera so you can send photos and live shots into your conversation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lexi needs photo library access to attach images to your messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Lexi needs to save generated images and screenshots to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lexi uses the microphone for voice messages and speech-to-text.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Lexi can use your location to give context-aware answers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Lexi can use your location in the background for ongoing context (e.g. travel, reminders, automation).
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Lexi can read your contacts to help you message, call, or look someone up.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Lexi can read and modify your calendar to help you plan and manage events.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Lexi can read and create reminders for you.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Lexi uses motion data for activity-aware features.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to unlock Lexi or authorise sensitive actions.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Lexi uses Bluetooth to interact with nearby devices.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Lexi uses Bluetooth to advertise to and exchange data with nearby devices.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Lexi uses the local network to discover devices.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Lexi uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice messages.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Lexi can read health data to give context-aware answers about activity, sleep, and fitness.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Lexi may use this identifier only for your personal automation, never for ads.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Lexi to save images to your gallery.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow Lexi to save files to your gallery.
